install.interview: Open LetsHyre, <signIn>sign in</signIn> with your candidate account and click Take Interview.

items.a: Windows computers. The macOS version is on the way, and this page will offer it as soon as it's ready.

items.q: What does the app use during the interview?
items.a: Your camera, microphone and screen, so the interview can be proctored. Before you start, it also checks that no blocked apps are running.
Yes. Sign in with the candidate account you applied with, then click Take Interview.

items.q: How do I uninstall the app?
items.a: Open Settings, go to Apps, find LetsHyre in the list and choose Uninstall.
